meta.title: Da Nang Day 5 🇻🇳 | Marble Mountains, Hoi An Night Market & Lantern Boat
meta.description:
Welcome to Vietnam Travel Vlog Day 5! In this vlog, we went on a half-day tour from Da Nang covering some of the most beautiful and cultural places in Central Vietnam—Marble Mountains and Hoi An Ancient Town ✨

We started our day by visiting the famous Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), known for their caves, temples, viewpoints, and panoramic views. This place is a must-visit when you’re in Da Nang and gives you a perfect mix of nature, history, and spirituality 🏔️🛕

After exploring Marble Mountains, our tour package included dinner, which made the trip very convenient and hassle-free 🍽️

Later in the evening, we headed to Hoi An Ancient Town, where we explored the colorful Hoi An Night Market, enjoyed shopping, street food, and the magical evening atmosphere 🌃

The highlight of the day was the Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride on the Thu Bon River. Floating lanterns, lights, and reflections make this experience truly unforgettable and one of the most romantic things to do in Vietnam 🏮🚣‍♂️

This vlog will help you understand how to plan a Marble Mountains and Hoi An tour from Da Nang, what’s included in the package, and whether it’s worth it—especially useful if you’re planning a Vietnam trip from India.

This video is part of my Vietnam travel series, where I share real experiences, travel routes, and tips from Phu Quoc, Da Nang, and Hanoi.

👉 If you enjoy Vietnam travel vlogs, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more Vietnam videos!
